First launch acquires exact profile ownership and opens Headquarters once. A repeated launch through the same runtime returns ALREADY_RUNNING without another Headquarters open.

A second ApplicationRuntime in the exact same process returns REOPEN_EXISTING and must not open a second Headquarters. Foreign ALIVE ownership is HELD_BY_OTHER and UNKNOWN liveness is UNCERTAIN; neither may be stolen.

If Headquarters open fails, APP-01A releases the just-acquired lease. If that cleanup also fails, the runtime enters RECOVERY_REQUIRED with exact lease ownership retained for explicit recovery.

Lease ownership and opened durable profile identity must match exactly. A memory opener that returns another profile is closed/refused and the requested profile lease is released rather than cross-linking runtime ownership.
Explicit quit closes Headquarters before releasing the exact lease. Close failure or lease-release failure stays RECOVERY_REQUIRED and never masquerades as STOPPED; both paths are retryable.

Successful quit reaches STOPPED and permits clean relaunch. Repository integration tests and consumer smoke exercise a real Headquarters profile and require the same active Song/version to survive quit/relaunch.
